_comment: Ashura Whole Heavens gear catalog. THIS is your single source of truth. To add/change gear: edit an entry (or copy one), commit, push — the Hardware page rebuilds itself. Fields: id, category (pc|peripherals|stream), icon (emoji), brand, name, blurb, badge, image (official URL or ''), asin (Amazon 10-char code or ''), amazonQ (search fallback), bestbuy (product-specific Impact link or '' to use the main link), free (true = show a plain link instead of Purchase modal), freeUrl/freeLabel.
